caption:
Figure 2. Illustration of the process for finetuning diffusion model and training the grounding head: (a) stable diffusion model is fine-tuned
on the detection dataset on base categories. (b) The grounding head is trained on synthetic images, with supervised learning on base
categories and self-training on novel categories.
delegated_acceptance_review: Viewed full original overview and enlarged grounding-head panel; caption reviewed. Synthetic dog/bottle image, detector/teacher/student,student→teacherEMA,basegreen/novelred annotations and Lbase+Lnovel retained. Added supervised-base/self-trained-novel and synthetic-training notes are explicit caption statements. Wholepaneldetail includes full input prompt/legend and owncaption.
